messages:
Maya: Overnight nightly-eval flagged a regression on rwd-open-7b-quant-v2. Promptset_A pass dropped to ~82% (was ~99%). Dashboard: https://redwood/dash/nightly/rwd-open-7b-quant-v2 — deploy around 02:10 UTC.
nightly-eval-bot: Run summary: promptset_A_failures=18, hallucination_score=0.32 (prev 0.06), BLEU delta -4.2, avg latency +12ms.
Ravi: Looking. Did we push a new tokenizer or change the quant recipe in the 02:00 build?
Tess: Release notes show model build 202 -> 203: tokenizer v2 uploaded, quant config updated to int8_symmetric (was int8_perchannel). See internal changelist CL#3241.
Owen: Quick check of serving logs: repeated tokenization warnings "unknown token id mapping" on ~12% of requests for that canary. Also seeing occasional OOM-like traces in quantize step during init.
Maya: Pasting one failing convo that surfaced in nightly (truncated):

```
User: Summarize the legal clause below.
Model: <nonsensical answer, hallucinated obligations and wrong references>
```
Ravi: That sample is classic tokenization mismatch symptom — different BPE merges produce different token boundaries => model gets shifted context. Also longer token sequences can trigger different KV cache behavior and exacerbate quant noise in embeddings.
Tess: I pulled model artifacts from storage: model-203 includes `tokenizer.json` and `vocab.bpe` but the serving bundle manifest still points to tokenizer v1 filenames (packaging bug).
Ravi: Also noticed quant logs: quantizer flagged `--per_channel=false` in the recipe used for 203. That makes embedding matrices use per-tensor symmetric scales — bad for heavy-tailed activations.
Owen: Repro steps that reproduce the drop locally:
1) checkout model:203
2) python tests/run_promptset.py --model rwd-open-7b:203 --quant int8_symmetric
Observed promptset_A pass ~81-83% and hallucination_score ~0.28.
Ravi: Root cause hypoth: packaging pipeline updated weights/tokenizer assets but didn't update the serving manifest; serving kept old tokenizer mapping. On top of that the quant recipe for the build used per-tensor symmetric quant for embeddings which inflated numeric error -> combined effect produced quality regression.
Tess: Immediate mitigation: rolled back serving model to build 202 and disabled the new int8 variant in routing. Canary traffic for 203 paused. (Maya: :thumbsup:)
DeployBot: Rollback completed at 1819457001 by Tess. Canary traffic switched. Health checks green.
Ravi: Longer-term actions I propose:
- Add tokenizer checksum validation during onboarding: fail if training artifact tokenizer != serving bundle tokenizer.
- Make per-channel quantization mandatory for embedding and projection layers in our int8 recipe; add unit test for outlier clipping.
- Add gating rule in the promotion pipeline: nightly eval promptset pass >= 98% AND hallucination_score <= 0.10 before auto-promotion.
- Add an integration CI test that runs tokenization diffs between the model package and serving bundle (simple token sequence equality for a seed set of inputs).
Tess: I will own the onboarding/pipeline change (tokenizer checksum + manifest check). ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Owen: I'll add canary automation and the gating enforcement in the deployment orchestrator. Also adding an alert if promptset pass drops >5% vs baseline and a tokenizer-checksum alert.
Ravi: I'll update the quantization recipes and add a small regression test: run quant on a copy of the embedding matrix then compare L2 error with per-channel vs per-tensor; fail if per-tensor error > threshold. Example snippet for the recipe change:

```
# old
quantize --model model.safetensors --mode int8_symmetric --per_channel false
# new
quantize --model model.safetensors --mode int8_perchannel --per_channel true --clip_outliers 0.01
```
Maya: Filing a follow-up postmortem doc and tracking ticket: PM-5813. I'll populate the postmortem with timeline and root cause. Link (placeholder): /docs/postmortems/1819456789-tokenizer-quant-triage
Ravi: Also adding an onboarding checklist entry: "verify tokenizer SHA and token count match training artifact" + unit test that runs sample tokenizations and diffs tokens.
Tess: Owners recap: Tess -> pipeline & manifest checks; Ravi -> quant recipe + tests; Owen -> canary automation & alerts; Maya -> postmortem & stakeholder comms. ETA for all: 48 hours for hotfixes, full rollout gated on nightly passing next run.
Maya: Thanks team. We'll re-run the nightly eval against the canary tonight and update this thread tomorrow AM with results.
